readerAnswers.news: Most existing AI learned from usual preserved slides, whose look differs from frozen tissue. CRISP was trained for frozen images. In an observational study — researchers watched normal care — it beat other AI models.
readerAnswers.mechanism: Most existing AI learned from usual preserved slides, whose look differs from frozen tissue. CRISP was trained for frozen images.
readerAnswers.limit: This does not show that CRISP improves treatment or patient outcomes.

terms.frozen section: A frozen section is tissue quickly frozen, sliced and examined during surgery.
terms.observational study: In an observational study — researchers watched normal care — it beat other AI models.

explainBack: Frozen tissue looks different from the slides most existing AI learned from, so CRISP was trained for frozen images. Its comparison result measures reading skill; a study that actually changes care and follows patients would test whether that skill improves outcomes.
unseenTransfer: If a hospital tests AI silently on existing X-rays, matching specialists shows reading skill. It still needs a study where the AI changes care to show better patient outcomes.
limitations: Producer review is not independent admission.
No patient benefit or availability claim is made.
